segments.text:
但我必须做出牺牲
But I have to make sacrifices.

为了保护你
To protect you,

我们之间永远不会有结果的
It was gonna workout between us.

因为 斯蒂芬
Because Stephen.

你总是想做主刀的那一个
You have to be the one holding the knife.

为此 我很敬佩你 但我无法为此爱上你
And I always respected you for it, but I couldn't love you for it.
